description: This file handles the MCQ exam page logic for an online examination system. It manages loading questions from a database, displaying options, timing the exam, and submitting answers to the database.

classes.name: MCQExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the MCQ Exam webpage, handling question loading, user interaction, timing, and result submission.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial loading of the exam page, retrieves questions from the database, initializes timer.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Redirects to the user profile page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates the score based on selected answers, stores results in database, navigates to results page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by redirecting to login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Handles countdown timer, updates time display, triggers timeout handling.
